text: EASTNORTHEAST is a compass bearing, and Sanborn's letter asks 'what's the point?'. This builds alphabets from every compass point and from the words of that letter.
On the EASTNORTHEAST alphabet places 22 and 29 force F and T in the same slot: dead for a 7-letter word.
42 alphabets, 1,764 pairings, repeating keys to 52, ciphertext autokey and both together: survivors at the shuffled rate, no word in the fragments.
